QuestInfo.name: [Missing Santa] To sleep Icarus
QuestInfo.1: You delivered a glass of warm milk to #b#p1052106##k. Hope he can go to bed early from now on. You should tell #b#p9220005##k in Happyville about this delivery, as he was worried.
QuestInfo.2: You told #b#p9220005##k that the glass of warm milk was successfully delivered to Icarus.

0.0: Hmm, what's this? Roodolph wanted you to deliver this glass of warm milk to me? Oh, so it's supposed to help me fall asleep after I drink it. I'm crossing my fingers!

yes.0: I really hope so. I don't know why I can't fall asleep on Christmas Eve. Maybe I'm too excited about it! I was really sad the past two years since I didn't get anything from Santa Claus, but now that you've told me about it I can finally go to bed. Thanks! Santa Claus will come visit me this time, right? Please thank Roodolph for me.

no.0: Any unfinished business in this town? Okay, please make sure to extend my thanks to Roodolph.

1.0: I can see that you have successfully given him the milk. He should be in la-la land by now. Good job! I would like to reward you for what you've done.

yes.0: Here, take this recommendation to the Christmas Tree and something nice will happen to you. Have a great holiday! Merry Christmas!

npc.0: You haven't met #b#p9220005##k yet. Please tell him I said 'thank you.'

item.0: You have to get I#b#p1052106##k a glass of warm milk soon or Santa Claus will just pass his house like he did last year!
